frame: Ornate lotus carved wooden frame on every plate

plates.beat_text: In the forest of exile the Pandavas keep a simple camp — and one divine gift that never runs dry by day.
must_show: Premium high-quality painted comic Amar Chitra forest hermitage camp
Simple leaf huts, peepal, golden hour forest clearing
Peaceful exile mood, equal natural human scale
Ornate lotus frame
plates.prompt: Premium high-quality painted comic Amar Chitra. Wide forest hermitage of the Pandavas in exile at cream-saffron golden hour. Simple leaf-and-wood huts, peepal tree, soft mist, distant hills. Quiet dignity of vanavasa. Ornate lotus wooden frame. Refined linework matching Ep01 gold master, not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: The Akshayapatra: so long as Draupadi has not finished her meal, the vessel feeds every guest.
must_show: Premium painted comic quality
Sacred golden Akshayapatra vessel glowing with divine abundance
Draupadi nearby or hands near vessel, food vessels and guests implied or soft
Warm holy light, lotus frame
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Draupadi in red-rose sari nearby with calm grace. Hermitage interior golden hour. Ornate lotus frame. Refined quality, not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: One evening the meal is done. Draupadi washes the vessel clean — and the day’s grace is sealed.
